column4: \t自由都市、Ｍランドに来たランス
column5: Rance has arrived at the Free Cities, M Land.

column4: \t兵士募集が必要だ。コパンドン
column5: We need to recruit soldiers. Copandon.

column4: \t少々やばそうな連中でもいい、そんな奴らの方がやるときにはやる
column5: It's alright even if they seem a bit shady; those kinds tend to actually fight when it matters.

column4: \tランスの無茶苦茶な指示により、７万ほどの兵士が集まった
column5: Due to Rance's reckless orders, about 70,000 soldiers have been gathered.
